issue.title: Crash in `dict` if `hash` `__eq__` function has side effects

labels.name: type-crash
labels.description: A hard crash of the interpreter, possibly with a core dump
pre-release feature fixes, bugs and security fixes

issue.body:
# Crash report

### What happened?

```python
import unittest
class Test(unittest.TestCase):
    def test(self):
        class X(object):
            def __hash__(self):
                return -1
            def __eq__(self, other):
                    d.clear()
        d = {}
        d[X()] = 3
        d[X()] = 4
        d[0.0] = 6
        self.assertIn(9, d)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

comments.body:
I've changed crasher a little and have assertion crash on debug build:

```python
-> % cat hash_crash.py
class X(object):
    def __hash__(self):
        return 1
    def __eq__(self, other):
        d.clear()

d = {}
x, y = X(), X()

d[x] = None
print(d)

d[y] = None
print(d)

-> % ./python hash_crash.py
{<__main__.X object at 0x7f318b692580>: None}
python: Objects/dictobject.c:403: unicode_get_hash: Assertion `PyUnicode_CheckExact(o)' failed.
[1]    143292 IOT instruction  ./python hash_crash.py
```

The crash is because we insert a non-unicode key into a dict that only supports unicode keys.

We check for this case at the beginning of `insertdict()`:

https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/95e5d596308620acbd860ec25a40ef95c2b62eaa/Objects/dictobject.c#L1877-L1881

But then the lookup clears the dict (going back to the empty keys, which are marked as unicode only):

https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/95e5d596308620acbd860ec25a40ef95c2b62eaa/Objects/dictobject.c#L1898-L1912

And when `insert_combined_dict` resizes, it keeps the keys object as unicode-only.

https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/95e5d596308620acbd860ec25a40ef95c2b62eaa/Objects/dictobject.c#L1778-L1783
